description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of six channel pairs, each followed by a fill element of a dynamic range payload and then SBR data: the fill element holds another payload next to the SBR payload, which the standard does not allow.
findings: 6 raw data blocks hold an SBR payload in a fill element with an extension payload of another type
6 of 6 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.decode: ffmpeg reads the dynamic range payload and the SBR data in one fill element differently.
